premises.text: The gift card market has $20 billion in unspent gift cards every year

premises.text: Gift cards often end up lost, stolen, or forgotten

premises.text: GIFT allows users to manage all their gift card needs from their mobile phone

premises.text: Uploading a card to GIFT is simple and verifies the card balance

premises.text: GIFT is integrated with Facebook for sending gift cards

premises.text: Anyone can receive a card on GIFT, regardless of phone type

premises.text: Redemption of gift cards is simple with barcode and numeric options
premises.evidence_span: Redemption is simple, with both barcode and numeric options

premises.text: Users can re-gift unwanted cards to friends

premises.text: GIFT will enable retailers and developers to leverage open APIs

premises.text: GIFT has secured over 200 national retail partners

value.text: GIFT simplifies the management and use of gift cards for consumers
value.evidence_span: GIFT is here to simplify your life
